= Graphviz Block

Graphviz on its own, rendered. `both-blocks.adoc` also carries a graphviz block, but only
to prove the block finder handles both delimiters -- it is never rendered there, so
without this file the `dot` path had no case of its own.

[graphviz]
----
digraph g {
  a -> b;
  b -> c;
}
----
